rationale: The isolated-network experiment executed (receipt e3bd14fe94534fbca3955cae4e521df7, experiment be2af26c5f2f43679ffe2592668f8388-experiment, status completed, outcome tests_passed, exit 0, no changed target files) and I read its receipt before writing. Both comparisons hold with complete admissions: index 0 is the admission (leader 1 of a real three-node network in StateLeader with committed 1 and committedEntryInCurrentTerm true, CheckQuorum false, ReadOnlySafe), and index 1 is the probe showing 32 same-context ReadIndex requests admitted as unconfirmed 32 with confirmed 0 while the leader is partitioned from both followers, together with 64 heartbeat messages. knowledge.statement: Measured on a real three-node network: after leader 1 was elected (committed 1, committedEntryInCurrentTerm true, CheckQuorum false, ReadOnlySafe) and then isolated from both followers, 32 same-context ReadIndex requests were all admitted as unconfirmed reads with confirmed 0 while the leader remained StateLeader, and the leader emitted 64 heartbeat messages, one to each of the two peers per request. So the outbound cost of a retry is one heartbeat per peer rather than a single message, scaling with the number of voters, and the retained read state grows by one entry per request in the same step.
knowledge.conditions: Real three-node raft network built with the package test helpers; the partition is expressed with the network helper's isolate for peers 2 and 3; CheckQuorum left at the library default of false so the leader is not required to step down; ReadOnlySafe is the default option. Outbound messages were counted and cleared each round, so the figure is the heartbeats produced, not a growing buffer. No claim is made about a real transport.

interpretations.rationale: Revision of the read-index retry-growth account after the isolated-network receipt. Receipt e3bd14fe94534fbca3955cae4e521df7 (experiment be2af26c5f2f43679ffe2592668f8388-experiment) ran in the isolated workspace; status completed, outcome tests_passed, exit 0, no changed target files, no parsing errors. Decisive parsed indices: 0 is the admission (real three-node network, leader 1 StateLeader after a MsgHup election, committed 1, in_term true, CheckQuorum false, ReadOnlySafe, three voters) and 1 is the probe (32 rounds, unconfirmed 32, broadcasts 64, confirmed 0, pending 0, still StateLeader); both comparisons evaluated holds with comparison_complete true and no missing indices. What this changes: the earlier revisions measured the same mechanism on direct instances by simply not delivering responses, and the limitation said the triggers were modelled rather than network-exercised; the partition here is expressed on a real three-node cluster, so the trigger is now network-configured, and the amplification figure is corrected upward to one heartbeat per peer per retry - 64 for 32 retries with two peers, rather than 32. The asserted claim is otherwise unchanged and its conditions are the ones previously recorded: ReadOnlySafe, a leader that cannot obtain quorum acknowledgements, CheckQuorum at its default of false so nothing closes the window, and a caller retrying with the documented pattern from node.go:218-224; under those conditions the library retains one read request per retry with no collapsing and no library-side reclamation while the process lives, pins caller-controlled payload equal to accepted requests times context size, emits one heartbeat per peer per retry, and releases the accumulated queue as a burst of one admission plus one heartbeat per entry per peer when the node next leads and commits. The refusal to answer reads without quorum remains correct and is not the complaint. Not claimed: total process footprint beyond the measured payload, an OOM threshold, transport saturation or any liveness failure; and etcd's own retry policy and context sizes remain unexamined.

knowledge.assertion: 32 retries on an isolated leader produced unconfirmed 32 and 64 heartbeats, one per peer per retry
the accumulated read state is process-local and cleared by a restart
retained payload equals accepted requests times caller-chosen context size

limitations: Severity is measured for retained caller payload and for the outbound heartbeat count; total process footprint, allocator overhead, an OOM threshold, transport saturation and liveness failure are not claimed.
The partition is expressed with the network helper's isolation rather than a real transport, and messages are counted in the leader's outbound buffer.
The accumulation is bounded by process lifetime because the state is not persisted; a restart clears it incidentally, which bounds severity but is not library-side reclamation.
etcd's own retry policy and RequestCtx sizes were not examined.
CheckQuorum at its default of false is what leaves the growth window open; with CheckQuorum true the window closes at step-down while the accumulated state is retained.
